description: This file defines the API routing structure for Mattermost's server, specifically for version 4 of the API. It sets up URL route hierarchies for users, teams, channels, posts, files, plugins, hooks, and other system components, and initializes API endpoints and handlers.

classes.name: Routes
classes.description: Struct holding various mux.Router pointers for different API route groups.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Struct representing the API server with a reference to the server and route definitions.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the main API routes, sets up subrouters for various API endpoints, and registers handlers.

methods.name: InitLocal
methods.description: Initializes local (possibly development or testing) API routes.

methods.name: Handle404
methods.description: Handles 404 errors by invoking web.Handle404 with a new app context.
